purpose: Deterministic technical data-quality scoring only. This policy does not calculate business loss, customer impact, regulatory exposure, or financial risk.

weight_renormalization.method: divide each available rule weight by the sum of available approved rule weights; return null when weighted coverage is below minimum_coverage_ratio

higher_is_better_linear.description: Return 0 at or below fail_at_or_below; return 100 at or above pass_at_or_above; linearly interpolate between them.

lower_is_better_linear.description: Return 100 at or below pass_at_or_below; return 0 at or above fail_at_or_above; linearly interpolate between them.

inside_range_linear.description: Return 100 within [pass_minimum, pass_maximum]; linearly decline to 0 at warning_minimum or warning_maximum; return 0 outside that outer range.

speaker_tag_validation.rationale: Speaker attribution is foundational to interpretation of agent/customer transcript interactions.

topic_drift.rationale: Distribution drift affects trend comparability and downstream topic reporting.

transcript_duration_vs_size.rationale: Transcript-duration plausibility is a supporting validity control.

fill_rate.rationale: Completeness is a cross-cutting prerequisite for reliable analytics.

non_english_mistranscription.rationale: Lexicon-detected mistranscription can reduce transcript interpretability.

privacy_detection.rationale: Detected PII in transcript fields requires prominent technical visibility.

spelling_validation.rationale: Spelling and unknown-token quality affects transcription usability when a governed vocabulary is available.
